name: Pixel Ant: Colony Feast
storyline: A hungry ant colony is preparing a great feast. Out in the world, delicious food cubes are piled up into pixel pictures, and the colony's squads must carry every last cube home to the nest. Helping the ants march out in the right order, the player travels through 33 worlds, uncovering each picture bite by bite and collecting a prize picture at the end of every world.
summary:
Pixel Ant: Colony Feast is a cozy pixel-art puzzle game about guiding color-coded ant squads to collect matching food cubes and complete each level’s picture. With only a few waiting slots, players must choose the order carefully to avoid blocking the colony.

Across 820 levels and 33 themed worlds, new obstacles and mechanics add variety to the sorting puzzles, alongside boss and prize pictures to collect. Boosters and unlockable table decorations provide extra ways to customize and tackle the challenges.
